prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for a Dreamerie spot-the-difference puzzle. Return ONE altered image with the EXACT SAME 4:5 framing, geometry, textured painted style and positions. Make exactly the five specified meaningful object edits below. Match this existing illustrator's brushwork, shading and palette. NO random new props, circular patches, tint spots, labels, arrows or answer markers. Keep absolutely everything else unchanged, including background, all edges, decorations and lighting. Do not redraw or reframe the scene. Coordinates are percentages from top-left and help identify objects, not visible boxes.
1. Edit only this object so: The bird's pink breast turned pale blue. Target near x40%, y28%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
2. Edit only this object so: The large red poppy turned ivory. Target near x88%, y75%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
3. Edit only this object so: The little cottage's square dark window became round. Target near x16%, y52%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
4. Edit only this object so: The bird closed its eye. Target near x49%, y23%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
5. Edit only this object so: The tiny four-point star immediately above the bird disappeared. Target near x50%, y13%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.

edits.label: The bird's pink breast turned pale blue.
The large red poppy turned ivory.
The little cottage's square dark window became round.
The bright four-point star above the bird disappeared.
